PHS Volleyball celebrated its seniors with a win during senior night, according to a post shared by Pontotoc Athletics.

The post, originally published by Trent’s Portrait Design, congratulated the seniors and the team on the win.

The shared post included the hashtags #beawarrior, #warriorpride, and #lifeisgood.
